messages:
ash: quick follow-up from postmortem INC-2026-042 — we need a tight playbook edit: concise triage steps, exact commands (including when logs are truncated), a short PD blurb, and a clear escalation ladder. can we assign owners?

incident-bot: On-call (2026-04-10) -> leo (SRE).

leo: ill take triage commands. plan: add an OBSERVE (0-5m) and MITIGATE (5-20m) section. will include: kubectl top, ps sorted by rss, pprof heap dump, and a curl to archived logs when stdout is truncated. aiming to open a docs PR by 2026-04-08.

natalie: ill handle escalation mapping and PD snippets. propose ladder: oncall -> infra-leads (10m) -> eng-sre/executive if cluster impact (20-40m). will include pd trigger examples and contact links.

ash: also add a prom rule suggestion so we catch growth earlier: increase(process_resident_memory_bytes{job="worker"}[5m]) > 1e8. if alert fires twice in 30m, auto-create incident and set P2.

leo: PD blurb (short): "Worker memory growth detected on <pod>. Triage started. Runbook: /docs/runbooks/worker-memory.md. Oncall: <oncall>."

natalie: owners & due dates: leo - triage + PR (due 2026-04-08); natalie - escalation + PD cmds (due 2026-04-09); ash - postmortem links + verify closures in oncall retro (due 2026-04-10).

ash: perfect. marking this thread as the canonical action tracker for the postmortem runbook/playbook updates. :white_check_mark:
